subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ABSORB
solution:
The correct answer is: Emit

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Absorb means to take something in, especially gradually.

 
 
• Example -* In cold climates, houses need to have walls that will **absorb **heat.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Emit means to throw or give off or out.
 
• Example - *The animal **emits **a powerful smell when scared.*
 
• It is clear that 'Absorb' and 'Emit' are opposite in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 4.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Swallow means to make a movement in your throat, often because you are afraid or surprised, etc.
 
• Imbibe means to absorb something, especially information.
 
• Consume means to devour, to take in, to use up.
